thread:
incident-bot: [P1] runtime queue depth rising in us-west-2 - increased latency and 502s for gen endpoints. Auto-mitigation didn't trigger. Paging eng-oncall.

jason (oncall): on it. pulling logs. assigning priya and marco to investigate.

priya: confirming spike starting ~00:38 UTC, in-flight per-gpu at 480/500 for a subset of tenants. backlog growth -> timeouts at frontlines.

marco: looks like a change in request distribution + a few heavy long-seq jobs. kernel scheduler queued. suggest immediate soft-shedding + lower max_inflight for low-priority slices.

jason (oncall): ok execute mitigations we can do without rolling code. priya do soft-shed + decrease max_inflight on routing layer for hosted-prod-low.

priya: running command now:
```
POST /admin/traffic-config
{
  "slice": "hosted-prod-low",
  "max_inflight": 200,
  "soft_shed": true
}
```

priya: applied. watching.

deploy-bot: config update deployed to us-west-2 (conf-id: cfg-6141592) :white_check_mark:

marco: also enabling priority timeout tuning to avoid long-running requests starving queue. increasing per-request timeout from 30s -> 45s for high-priority tenants only.

jason (oncall): good. liz please draft customer-facing note for impacted customers; mark affected tenants list attached.

liz (support): drafting. sending opt-in for quota bump to paying customers who hit errors. message preview:
"We're seeing elevated latency in us-west-2 affecting gen endpoints. We're actively mitigating by throttling low-priority traffic and tuning timeouts. If you're experiencing errors please reply and we'll prioritize your tenant."

taylan: taking over in 20m for handoff. summary: mitigations applied: (1) max_inflight lowered for hosted-prod-low -> 200, (2) soft_shed enabled, (3) high-priority timeout bumped to 45s, (4) streaming_v2 feature toggled OFF for tenants in list heavy-ttl.

marco: one more immediate tweak: enable prefix KV cache for streaming requests on us-west-2 -- should drop token work by ~20%.

priya: KV-cache enabled. metrics show backlog decreasing, p50 latency trending down. 502 rate dropping.

jason (oncall): leaving note for taylan: keep soft_shed on until Q<0.1 and in-flight stable < 220 for 5m. escalate to infra if backpressure persists.

taylan: ack. I'll monitor next 30m and prepare rollback plan for config changes. ping me if customer impact rises.

incident-bot: Incident P1 -> status: mitigated (partial). continued monitoring.

liz (support): customer message sent to impacted list, support channel opened. :email:

jason (oncall): thanks team. will update post-incident report with root cause and next steps for auto-mitigation thresholds.
